title: VibeVoice Realtime TTS
description: Low-latency expressive text-to-speech using microsoft/VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B. Weights and 26 multilingual voice presets are baked into the image, so there is no cold-start download.

input.name: Default voice preset
input.description: Voice used when a request omits the 'voice' field.

input.name: CFG scale
input.description: Classifier-free guidance strength. Upstream default is 1.5.

input.name: Diffusion steps
input.description: Diffusion steps per chunk. Higher is slower and smoother. Upstream default is 5.

input.name: Attention implementation
input.description: sdpa needs no extra wheel. flash_attention_2 is fully tested upstream but must be installed into the image first.
